title: The Regularity datum on time-varying graph domains and Dirichlet--Regularity duality
summary: In this paper we address a basic question that has not been considered in the literature on the parabolic Regularity problem. Let $Ω$ be the region above the graph of a $\mathrm{Lip}(1,\tfrac12)$ function $φ$ on $\mathbb R^{n-1}\times\mathbb R$. The corresponding $\dot L^p_{1,1/2}$ Regularity boundary space on $\partialΩ$ is defined by pulling the datum back to the flat space where we have the norm $\|\nabla f\|_{L^p}+\|D^{1/2}_t f\|_{L^p}$. As there is more than one graph parametrisation of such a domain, this could petentially lead to different notions of $\dot L^p_{1,1/2}(\partialΩ)$.…
